subject: english
question:
**Direction: Substitute the underlined words with the option that is closest in meaning to it.**

**__Do not pay attention to__** his words.
solution: The correct answer is **"Ignore".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Ignore"** means to pay no attention to something or someone. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर कोई ध्यान न देना, की उपेक्षा करना) • It is a verb that can be used in various tenses, such as **"ignored", "ignoring", and "will ignore".** • **Example: ***I said hello to Dolly but she totally ignored me.* • In this sentence, the speaker is telling someone not to pay attention to what another person is saying. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Negate"**, means to deny or nullify something. (बेअसर या अशक्त करना; बेकार करना; निष्फल करना) • **Option 2, "Accept"**, means to agree to something or to believe it is true. ((दी गई वस्‍तु को) स्‍वीकार या ग्रहण करना) • **Option 4, "Fight"**, means to engage in a physical or verbal confrontation. (शारीरिक शक्ति, हथियारों आदि से किसी के विरुद्घ लड़ना) 30:T6bc, The correct answer is **"A wealthy man with lots of money and assets."**
